integrity: A symbolic all-parameter proof uses the exact aligned prefix-count equation, full boundary-case extrema, telescoping to establish both mismatch orientations at every lag, and unit-step contiguity. A standalone Python verifier checks parameter and length ranges independently.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified binary Parikh-constant one-marker substitutions are classified. The general periodicity question for Parikh-constant morphisms remains open. The b=2 Thue-Morse case is previously known. An unindexed earlier exact calculation is an originality risk.
title: Exact Abelian factor spectra for a uniform one-marker substitution family
